1. Project scope

Pages × $80 each. Typical: 1 (landing), 4–5 (small business), 8+ (content sites).

2. Fixed quote

Quote valid 14 days. 50% deposit to start, 50% before launch. $5 idea-call fee credited if they proceed within 14 days.

Base covers setup, deploy, mobile-responsive build, basic SEO + analytics, launch + handoff doc. All constants are starting points at the top of the <script> — adjust as you get proof of demand. Sample totals are format examples, not promises.
